issues.description: The Person model's 'firstName' field has different visibility between template and solution. In the template Person.java the field is declared private, while in the solution Person.java it is declared public. This discrepancy is structural (field visibility) and may confuse students when comparing their work to the provided solution or when relying on encapsulation conventions used elsewhere in the codebase.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Preferably change the solution's Person.java to declare 'firstName' as private (and keep the existing getter/setter), matching the template and preserving encapsulation. Alternatively, if public field was intentional, update the template Person.java to make 'firstName' public and document the reason.
